uplink.description: work mode 1 (2ACI+2AVI): all four analog positions plus three digital-input positions
uplink._note: TTN example input. byte[10]=0x01 -> hardware 0 (LT33222, so DI3/DO3 exist), mode 1. avi0=AVI1=s16(0x04AB)=1195/1000=1.195 V, avi1=AVI2=s16(0x04AC)=1.196 V, aci0=ACI1=s16(0x1310)=4.88 mA, aci1=ACI2=s16(0x1300)=4.864 mA. byte[8]=0xAA: DI1(bit3)=1 -> input0 closed, DI2(bit4)=0 -> input1 open, DI3(bit5)=1 -> input2 closed; DO1 H, DO2 L, DO3 H, RO1 ON, RO2 OFF. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (AVI1_V 1.195, AVI2_V 1.196, ACI1_mA 4.88, ACI2_mA 4.864, DI1 'H', DI2 'L', DI3 'H', DO1 'H', DO2 'L', DO3 'H', RO1 'ON', RO2 'OFF').

uplink.description: work mode 1 on LT22222 hardware: distinct value per position, mixed input states, no third DI/DO
uplink._note: Multi-position vector: every position carries a different value, so a per-position mix-up cannot pass. byte[10]=0x41 -> hardware 1 (LT22222: 2 DI / 2 DO, so no input2 entry and no do3), mode 1. AVI1=0x3039=12345 -> 12.345 V, AVI2=0x01F4=500 -> 0.5 V, ACI1=0x4E20=20000 -> 20 mA, ACI2=0x0FA0=4000 -> 4 mA. byte[8]=0xC9: DI1(bit3)=1 -> input0 closed, DI2(bit4)=0 -> input1 open, DO1 bit0=1 -> do1 false, DO2 bit1=0 -> do2 true, RO1 bit7=1, RO2 bit6=1. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (Hardware_mode 'LT22222', AVI1_V 12.345, AVI2_V 0.5, ACI1_mA 20, ACI2_mA 4, DI1 'H', DI2 'L', DO1 'L', DO2 'H', RO1 'ON', RO2 'ON', and no DI3_status/DO3_status).

uplink.description: work mode 2 (double DI counting): two counter positions, no analog positions
uplink._note: Second work mode, exercising the lazy channels build: mode 2 reports only the counter bank, so no avi*/aci*/input* entries are emitted. byte[10]=0x02 -> mode 2. COUNT1=0x000003E8=1000 -> counter0, COUNT2=0x000007D0=2000 -> counter1. byte[8]=0 so all DO high / RO off. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (Count1_times 1000, Count2_times 2000, no AVI/ACI/DI fields).

uplink.description: work mode 3 (1 DI counter + 2ACI): mixed banks - one counter position and both current positions
uplink._note: Third work mode: counter bank + current bank, and NO voltage or digital-input entries (mode 3 does not report them). byte[10]=0x03 -> hardware 0, mode 3. COUNT1=0x0001E240=123456 -> counter0, ACI1=0x2134=8500 -> 8.5 mA, ACI2=0x3D86=15750 -> 15.75 mA. byte[8]=0x21: DO1 bit0=1 -> do1 false, DO2 bit1=0 -> do2 true, DO3 bit2=0 -> do3 true, RO1/RO2 clear; bit5 here is upstream's FIRST flag, not DI3, which is why no input entry is emitted outside mode 1. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (Count1_times 123456, ACI1_mA 8.5, ACI2_mA 15.75, First_status 'Yes').

uplink.description: work mode 4 (DI counter + AVI1 threshold counter): counter0 and acount0
uplink._note: Covers the position the pre-channels codec dropped: mode 4 carries COUNT1 in bytes[0..3] AND ACOUNT (the AVI1 threshold-crossing counter) in bytes[4..7], but the old shape mapped only bytes[4..7] onto pulse.count. byte[10]=0x44 -> hardware 1 (LT22222, no do3), mode 4. COUNT1=0x00000007=7 -> counter0, ACOUNT=0x00010002=65538 -> acount0 (distinct values, so the two 32-bit reads cannot be swapped unnoticed). byte[8]=0x82: DO1 bit0=0 -> do1 true, DO2 bit1=1 -> do2 false, RO1 bit7=1 -> true, RO2 bit6=0 -> false. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (Count1_times 7, Acount_times 65538).

uplink.description: work mode 5 (1ACI+2AVI+1Count): both voltage positions, ACI1 only, 16-bit counter
uplink._note: Fourth work mode: three banks at once and an aci1 that must NOT appear (mode 5 reports only ACI1). byte[10]=0x05 -> hardware 0, mode 5. AVI1=0x0CE4=3300 -> 3.3 V, AVI2=0xFC18=-1000 -> -1 V (signed 16-bit path; analog.voltage has no lower bound in the vocabulary, unlike analog.current), ACI1=0x0FA1=4001 -> 4.001 mA, COUNT1 is the 16-bit 0x1234=4660 -> counter0. byte[8]=0x44: DO1 bit0=0 -> do1 true, DO2 bit1=0 -> do2 true, DO3 bit2=1 -> do3 false, RO2 bit6=1 -> true, RO1 bit7=0 -> false. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (AVI1_V 3.3, AVI2_V -1, ACI1_mA 4.001, Count1_times 4660).

uplink.description: work mode 6 (exit/alarm) carries only flag bits, no measured position

errors: work mode 6 carries no normalizable interface reading

uplink._note: byte[10]=0x06 -> mode 6. Upstream decodes this frame into AV/AC/DI threshold flags only (no AVI/ACI/count value), so there is no position to emit and the frame is rejected rather than shipping an empty channels array.
